title: Fingerprinting and deterministic slices for profile generation
creator: Aisha Kumari
description:
Problem: Model onboarding and stable profile publishing require repeatable, auditable benchmark runs across changing datasets, prompt variants, and eval runners. Current harness runs produce noisy profiles when dataset sampling or prompt selection is non-deterministic; this causes churn in model pins and undermines rollout safety.

Goal: Build a fingerprinting + deterministic-slice subsystem for the benchmark harness that: 1) computes stable, compact fingerprints for dataset slices and prompt variants; 2) ties fingerprints to model-onboarding metadata and model version pins; 3) enables reproducible reruns (same seeds, same runner shims) and deterministic sampling for delta profiling; 4) emits provenance metadata into the profile artifact for downstream publish and traceability.

Success criteria / acceptance: 
- Harness can reproduce a profile run from a fingerprint + run config (same inputs -> identical token-level summary metrics within floating noise tolerances).
- Profile artifacts include a provenance block (fingerprints, runner-shim-version, dataset-hash, prompt-variant-hash, seed).
- Publishing pipeline can detect benign reordering vs. true regression by comparing fingerprints and percent-change thresholds.
- Engineering tests cover fingerprint collisions (property checks) and deterministic slice replay in CI.

Design notes: 
- Use a two-tier fingerprint: (A) dataset slice fingerprint computed from canonicalized example IDs + normalized metadata, hashed (SHA256 hex), (B) prompt-variant fingerprint derived from canonicalized template + argument normalization and tokenizer-normalized representation. Store both as short hex (first 12 chars) plus full hash in artifact.
- Provide a "runner shim" version tag: harness-runner v2.1+ will embed the binary/adapter checksum so changes in low-level tokenization or metric computation invalidate a run explicitly.
- Add a reproducibility token: combination of seed, batcher config, KV-cache strategy, and kernel-selection-override. This token is included in the profile manifest so we can unconditional rerun in a pinned infra environment.
- Deterministic sampling strategy: support two modes: static-index-slice (index based, stable across dataset ordering) and stratified-seed-slice (stratify by label/length and use a fixed RNG seed per slice). Default for onboarding is stratified-seed-slice to reduce covariate shift on label distribution.
- Provide a CLI/SDK helper: harness fingerprint create/replay that takes dataset path + prompt set + runner config and emits fingerprint + manifest and an optional "replay plan" for CI reproduction.

Trade-offs considered: 
- Including full example content in fingerprint improves collision resistance but increases artifact size. We chose canonicalized IDs + metadata for compactness and add full-hash fallback for sensitive collisions.
- Determinism vs. diversity: fully deterministic slices help auditability but can under-expose corner cases; we keep sampling mode configurable and provide a periodic stochastic-runjob for stress testing.

Rollout plan: 
1) Implement fingerprint library and unit tests (2 sprints).
2) Add manifest emission to harness and wire into profile artifactization (1 sprint).
3) Integrate into onboarding flow and publish checks in the model-onboarding pipeline (1 sprint).
4) Canary: run fingerprinted harness on next 10 model onboarding runs and compare diff noise.

Compatibility: Must work with existing eval-runner adapters (see runner-adapter spec). Will add minimal adapter shim for older runners to emit runner-shim-version.

Security & privacy: Do not embed sensitive user prompts or PII in fingerprints. Canonicalization step redacts PII fields per the data policy before hashing.
comments: 2026-02-19 - Aisha Kumari: Kickoff meeting notes posted to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/pages/fingerprint-harness. Agreed on SHA256 base, 12-char short ID and full-hash in manifest.

2026-02-23 - Tomás Rivera: PoC library added to repo (github.com/redwood-inference/harness/tree/feature/fingerprint-poc). Small script to compute dataset index-based slice fingerprints. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/harness/pull/612
2026-02-27 - Review (Lena Hart): Design feedback to add runner-shim checksum and require tokenizer-normalized prompt variant for cross-tokenizer parity. Added as action item.

2026-03-01 - Tomás Rivera: Implemented prompt canonicalizer and prompt-variant hashing. Edge case: templates with non-deterministic formatting (float repr) cause small diffs; normalized float formatting to 6 digits fixed it.

2026-03-03 - QA (Samir Patel): Deterministic replay test added to CI; three deterministically generated slices reproduced within acceptable metric variance. Filing follow-up to increase test coverage for heavy tail labels (ENG-324561).

2026-03-05 - PM review (Ivy Chen): PM asked for UX in Console to surface fingerprint diffs and an explanation when publish is blocked by changed runner shim. Created PM ticket to expose minimal fingerprint metadata in profile view.
